list.name: env
list.label: Env
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['env'] FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY 1

list.name: clusters
list.label: Clusters
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['clusters'] AS c FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY toUInt32OrZero(c)

list.name: chart
list.label: Fleet chart
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['fleet_version'] AS v FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC

list.name: va
list.label: Compare A
list.description: Defaults to the second highest Fleet chart version
list.query: SELECT v FROM (SELECT v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC) AS r FROM (SELECT DISTINCT labels['fleet_version'] AS v FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run')) ORDER BY r = 2 DESC, r

list.name: vb
list.label: with B
list.description: Defaults to the highest Fleet chart version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['fleet_version'] AS v FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC

list.name: test
list.label: Test (by setup)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT labels['scenario'] FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY 1

list.name: metric
list.label: Measurement (by setup)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM fleet_scale_results WHERE metric NOT IN ('run', 'event') ORDER BY 1

list.name: run
list.label: Run (timeline)
list.query: SELECT run_label AS __value, concat(formatDateTime(ts, '%F %R'), ' · ', labels['scenario'], ' · ', labels['env'], ' ', labels['clusters'], ' clusters · Fleet ', labels['fleet_version'], ' · ', labels['status']) AS __text FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' ORDER BY ts DESC

panels.title: Pass/fail history (newest Fleet chart first)
panels.description: One row per day (per Fleet chart, env and cluster count); a test run again the same day goes to an extra repeat row (Date '... r1', '... r2'), one column per test.

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT concat('{"Fleet chart":', toJSONString(v), ',"Date":', toJSONString(concat(formatDateTime(batch, '%F'), if(toSecond(batch) > 1, concat(' r', toString(toSecond(batch) - 1)), ''))), ',"Env":', toJSONString(env), ',"Clusters":', toJSONString(clusters), ',"Published":', if(pub = 1, '"yes"', '"no"'), '}') AS Batch, Test AS Col, concat(argMax(st, ts), if(count() > 1, concat(' (', toString(countIf(st != 'PASSED')), ' of ', toString(count()), ' failed)'), '')) AS Cell, any(v) AS vv, max(batch) AS bb FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, metric AS m, unit AS u, labels['env'] AS env, labels['clusters'] AS clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, published AS pub, labels['status'] AS st, ts, value, b.batch AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results AS r FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT run_label, toDateTime(toDate(ts)) + toIntervalSecond(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY labels['env'], labels['fleet_version'], labels['clusters'], toDate(ts), labels['scenario'] ORDER BY ts)) AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run') AS b USING run_label WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY Batch, Col) SELECT Batch, Col AS Test, Cell AS Status FROM (SELECT 0 AS hdr, Batch, Col, Cell, vv, bb FROM g UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1, '~', Col, '', '', toDateTime(0) FROM g) ORDER BY hdr DESC, if(hdr = 1, Col, ''), (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', vv)[1])), position(vv, '-') = 0, extract(vv, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(vv, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, bb DESC

panels.title: Test runs: passed / not passing
panels.description: Every test run, repeats included, with the filters at the top. Green = PASSED; every other slice = the runs of that test that did not pass (FAILED or ERROR), red for the test failing most, then orange, yellow, ... NOT PASSED in the legend = all slices except PASSED together.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, n, colour FROM (SELECT name, n, if(name = 'PASSED', 'green', ['red', 'orange', 'yellow', '#FFB357', 'dark-red', 'dark-orange', '#E0B400', '#FFCB7D'][(r - 1) % 8 + 1]) AS colour FROM (SELECT name, n, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY name = 'PASSED', n DESC, name) AS r FROM (SELECT if(labels['status'] = 'PASSED', 'PASSED', labels['scenario']) AS name, toUInt32(count()) AS n FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY name)) UNION ALL SELECT concat('NOT PASSED (', toString(round(100 * sumIf(n, name != 'PASSED') / sum(n))), '%)'), toUInt32(sumIf(n, name != 'PASSED')), 'semi-dark-red' FROM (SELECT if(labels['status'] = 'PASSED', 'PASSED', labels['scenario']) AS name, toUInt32(count()) AS n FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY name)) ORDER BY multiIf(name = 'PASSED', 0, startsWith(name, 'NOT PASSED'), 1, 2), n DESC, name

panels.title: Test runs passed per Fleet chart
panels.description: Every test run, repeats included, with the filters at the top. Green = share of runs that passed, red = share that did not pass. Example: 8 runs, 7 passed = 87.5% green, 12.5% red.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(labels['fleet_version'], '  ·  ', toString(countIf(labels['status'] = 'PASSED')), ' of ', toString(count()), ' passed (', toString(round(100 * countIf(labels['status'] = 'PASSED') / count(), 1)), '%)') AS name, 1 AS value, countIf(labels['status'] = 'PASSED') / count() AS p, p + 0.000001 AS p2, p + 0.000002 AS p3 FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY labels['fleet_version'] ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', labels['fleet_version'])[1])), position(labels['fleet_version'], '-') = 0, extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Click a test to see its timeline at the bottom.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS Finished, labels['scenario'] AS Test, labels['status'] AS Status, labels['fleet_version'] AS `Fleet chart`, concat(labels['env'], ' · ', labels['clusters'], if(published = 1, ' · published', ' · not published')) AS Setup, labels['actual'] AS Reason, run_label FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['status'] != 'PASSED' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', labels['fleet_version'])[1])), position(labels['fleet_version'], '-') = 0, extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, ts DESC

panels.title: Test duration per batch (newest Fleet chart first)
panels.description: Average duration of the passed runs of each test in the batch; FAILED if none passed. Colour: compared with the average of the same test in the same setup (env + cluster count) over the shown batches. Green = at or below average (or less than 10% above), yellow = 10–24% slower/higher, orange = 25–49%, red = 50% or more.

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT Batch, Col, if(isNull(x), 'FAILED', concat(multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), concat(' (', if(x >= a, '+', ''), toString(toInt64(round(100 * (x - a) / a))), '%)'))) AS Cell, vv, bb FROM (SELECT Batch, Col, x, vv, bb, avg(x) OVER (PARTITION BY Col, env, clusters) AS a FROM (SELECT concat('{"Fleet chart":', toJSONString(v), ',"Date":', toJSONString(concat(formatDateTime(batch, '%F'), if(toSecond(batch) > 1, concat(' r', toString(toSecond(batch) - 1)), ''))), ',"Env":', toJSONString(env), ',"Clusters":', toJSONString(clusters), ',"Published":', if(pub = 1, '"yes"', '"no"'), '}') AS Batch, Test AS Col, env, clusters, any(v) AS vv, max(batch) AS bb, avgOrNullIf(value, st = 'PASSED') AS x FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, metric AS m, unit AS u, labels['env'] AS env, labels['clusters'] AS clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, published AS pub, labels['status'] AS st, ts, value, b.batch AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results AS r FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT run_label, toDateTime(toDate(ts)) + toIntervalSecond(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY labels['env'], labels['fleet_version'], labels['clusters'], toDate(ts), labels['scenario'] ORDER BY ts)) AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run') AS b USING run_label WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY Batch, Col, env, clusters))) SELECT Batch, Col AS Test, Cell AS Cell FROM (SELECT 0 AS hdr, Batch, Col, Cell, vv, bb FROM g UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1, '~', Col, '', '', toDateTime(0) FROM g) ORDER BY hdr DESC, if(hdr = 1, Col, ''), (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', vv)[1])), position(vv, '-') = 0, extract(vv, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(vv, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, bb DESC

panels.title: Measurements per batch (newest Fleet chart first)
panels.description: Columns: test number + measurement (BDs = bundledeployments). Per batch: average for durations, maximum for counts and sizes. Old runs: read from the text lines. Counts that are 0 everywhere just show 0. Colour: compared with the average of the same test in the same setup (env + cluster count) over the shown batches. Green = at or below average (or less than 10% above), yellow = 10–24% slower/higher, orange = 25–49%, red = 50% or more.

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT Batch, Col, if(a = 0, multiIf(u = 's', multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), u = 'bytes', concat(toString(round(x / 1048576)), ' MiB'), toString(round(x, 1))), concat(multiIf(u = 's', multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), u = 'bytes', concat(toString(round(x / 1048576)), ' MiB'), toString(round(x, 1))), concat(' (', if(x >= a, '+', ''), toString(toInt64(round(100 * (x - a) / a))), '%)'))) AS Cell, vv, bb FROM (SELECT Batch, Col, mu AS u, x, vv, bb, avg(x) OVER (PARTITION BY Col, env, clusters) AS a FROM (SELECT concat('{"Fleet chart":', toJSONString(v), ',"Date":', toJSONString(concat(formatDateTime(batch, '%F'), if(toSecond(batch) > 1, concat(' r', toString(toSecond(batch) - 1)), ''))), ',"Env":', toJSONString(env), ',"Clusters":', toJSONString(clusters), ',"Published":', if(pub = 1, '"yes"', '"no"'), '}') AS Batch, concat(substring(Test, 1, 2), ' ', replaceAll(replaceAll(replaceRegexpOne(replaceRegexpOne(m, '_(seconds|bytes)$', ''), '^update_latency_phase[0-9]-([a-z]+)$', '\\1_latency'), 'bundledeployments', 'BDs'), '_', ' ')) AS Col, env, clusters, any(u) AS mu, any(v) AS vv, max(batch) AS bb, if(any(u) = 's', avg(value), max(value)) AS x FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, metric AS m, unit AS u, labels['env'] AS env, labels['clusters'] AS clusters, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, published AS pub, labels['status'] AS st, ts, value, b.batch AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results AS r FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT run_label, toDateTime(toDate(ts)) + toIntervalSecond(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY labels['env'], labels['fleet_version'], labels['clusters'], toDate(ts), labels['scenario'] ORDER BY ts)) AS batch FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run') AS b USING run_label WHERE metric NOT IN ('run', 'event') AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY Batch, Col, env, clusters))) SELECT Batch, Col AS Measurement, Cell AS Cell FROM (SELECT 0 AS hdr, Batch, Col, Cell, vv, bb FROM g UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1, '~', Col, '', '', toDateTime(0) FROM g) ORDER BY hdr DESC, if(hdr = 1, Col, ''), (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', vv)[1])), position(vv, '-') = 0, extract(vv, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(vv, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, bb DESC

panels.title: Duration of ${test} by setup (newest Fleet chart first)
panels.description: Average duration of the passed runs of the test picked at the top, all days and repeats together; FAILED if none passed. Columns: setup (env + cluster count). Local k3d and AWS are not comparable, so compare within a column only: colour = compared with the column average. Green = at or below the column average (or less than 10% above), yellow = 10–24% slower/higher, orange = 25–49%, red = 50% or more.

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT Row, Col, if(isNull(x), 'FAILED', concat(multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), concat(' (', if(x >= a, '+', ''), toString(toInt64(round(100 * (x - a) / a))), '%)'))) AS Cell, v, '' AS t, k FROM (SELECT Row, Col, v, k, x, avg(x) OVER (PARTITION BY Col) AS a FROM (SELECT labels['fleet_version'] AS Row, concat(labels['env'], ' ', labels['clusters']) AS Col, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, toUInt32OrZero(labels['clusters']) AS k, avgOrNullIf(value, labels['status'] = 'PASSED') AS x FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['scenario'] = '${test}' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY Row, Col, v, k))) SELECT Row AS `Fleet chart`, Col AS Setup, Cell FROM (SELECT 0 AS hdr, Row, Col, Cell, v, t, k FROM g UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1, '~', Col, '', '', '', k FROM g) ORDER BY hdr DESC, if(hdr = 1, k, 0), if(hdr = 1, Col, ''), (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, t

panels.title: ${metric} by setup (per test, newest Fleet chart first)
panels.description: Measurement picked at the top, one row per Fleet chart and test (some measurements come from more than one test). Average for durations, maximum for counts and sizes, all days and repeats together. Columns: setup (env + cluster count). Compare within a column only: colour = compared with the average of the same test in that column. Green = at or below the column average (or less than 10% above), yellow = 10–24% slower/higher, orange = 25–49%, red = 50% or more.

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT Row, Col, if(a = 0, multiIf(u = 's', multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), u = 'bytes', concat(toString(round(x / 1048576)), ' MiB'), toString(round(x, 1))), concat(multiIf(u = 's', multiIf(x < 60, concat(toString(round(x)), ' s'), concat(toString(round(x / 60, 1)), ' min')), u = 'bytes', concat(toString(round(x / 1048576)), ' MiB'), toString(round(x, 1))), concat(' (', if(x >= a, '+', ''), toString(toInt64(round(100 * (x - a) / a))), '%)'))) AS Cell, v, t, k FROM (SELECT Row, Col, v, t, k, u, x, avg(x) OVER (PARTITION BY Col, t) AS a FROM (SELECT concat('{"Test":', toJSONString(labels['scenario']), ',"Fleet chart":', toJSONString(labels['fleet_version']), '}') AS Row, concat(labels['env'], ' ', labels['clusters']) AS Col, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, labels['scenario'] AS t, toUInt32OrZero(labels['clusters']) AS k, any(unit) AS u, if(any(unit) = 's', avg(value), max(value)) AS x FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = '${metric}' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY Row, Col, v, t, k))) SELECT Row AS Key, Col AS Setup, Cell FROM (SELECT 0 AS hdr, Row, Col, Cell, v, t, k FROM g UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1, '~', Col, '', '', '', k FROM g) ORDER BY hdr DESC, if(hdr = 1, k, 0), if(hdr = 1, Col, ''), t, (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', v)[1])), position(v, '-') = 0, extract(v, '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(v, '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC

panels.title: Compare Fleet ${va} (A) with ${vb} (B)
panels.description: Pick A and B at the top. Durations are averages of passed runs; only compare rows with the same setup. Change: green = B faster by more than 10%, red = B slower by more than 10%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Test, Setup, multiIf(countIf(v = '${va}') = 0, '', countIf(v = '${va}' AND st != 'PASSED') > 0, 'FAILED', 'PASSED') AS `A`, avgOrNullIf(value, v = '${va}' AND st = 'PASSED') AS `Duration A`, multiIf(countIf(v = '${vb}') = 0, '', countIf(v = '${vb}' AND st != 'PASSED') > 0, 'FAILED', 'PASSED') AS `B`, avgOrNullIf(value, v = '${vb}' AND st = 'PASSED') AS `Duration B`, round(100 * (`Duration B` - `Duration A`) / `Duration A`, 1) AS Change FROM (SELECT labels['scenario'] AS Test, concat(labels['env'], ' ', labels['clusters'], ' clusters') AS Setup, labels['fleet_version'] AS v, labels['status'] AS st, value FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['fleet_version'] IN ('${va}', '${vb}') AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) GROUP BY Test, Setup ORDER BY Test, Setup

panels.title: All runs
panels.description: One line per test run. Click a test name to see its timeline at the bottom.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS Finished, labels['scenario'] AS Test, labels['status'] AS Status, labels['env'] AS Env, toUInt32OrNull(labels['clusters']) AS Clusters, toUInt32OrNull(labels['bundles']) AS Bundles, labels['fleet_version'] AS `Fleet chart`, labels['image'] AS `Controller image`, if(published = 1, 'published', 'not published') AS Source, value AS Duration, labels['actual'] AS Result, run_label FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'run' AND labels['env'] IN (${env:singlequote}) AND published IN (${source:csv}) AND labels['clusters'] IN (${clusters:singlequote}) AND labels['fleet_version'] IN (${chart:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY (arrayMap(n -> toUInt32OrZero(n), splitByChar('.', splitByChar('-', labels['fleet_version'])[1])), position(labels['fleet_version'], '-') = 0, extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-([a-z]+)'), toUInt32OrZero(extract(labels['fleet_version'], '-[a-z]+[.]?([0-9]+)'))) DESC, ts DESC

panels.title: Timeline of the selected run (pick it in 'Run (timeline)' above, or click a test in a table)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS Time, value AS `Since start`, labels['event'] AS Event FROM fleet_scale_results FINAL WHERE metric = 'event' AND run_label = '${run}' ORDER BY ts, `Since start`
